episodeTitle.en: Becoming evidence-guided | Itamar Gilad (Gmail, YouTube, Microsoft)
episodeTitle.zh: 以证据为导向 | 伊塔马尔·吉拉德（曾任谷歌、微软等公司产品高管）

guestBioOfficial.en: Itamar Gilad is a product coach, author, and speaker with over two decades of experience in senior product roles at Google, Microsoft, and various startups. He is also the author of Evidence-Guided: Creating High-Impact Products in the Face of Uncertainty and publishes a popular product management newsletter. In today’s episode, we discuss: • What it means to be “evidence-guided”
guestBioOfficial.zh: 伊塔马尔·吉拉德是一位拥有二十多年产品管理经验的产品教练、作家和演讲者。他曾在谷歌、微软等公司担任高级产品职位，并著有《以证据为导向：在不确定性中创造高影响力产品》一书，还运营着广受欢迎的产品管理通讯。在本期节目中，我们将探讨：• “以证据为导向”的含义

title.en: Becoming evidence-guided | Itamar Gilad (Gmail, YouTube, Microsoft)
title.zh: 以证据为导向 | 伊塔马尔·吉拉德（曾任谷歌、微软等公司产品高管）

summary.en: Itamar makes the case for moving teams from opinion-based to evidence-guided decision-making, and shares practical frameworks to do it: the confidence meter, metrics trees, GIST and the GIST board, and a critique of how people mis-use ICE for prioritization. He also covers how to run effective fake-door and Wizard-of-Oz tests (including how the tabbed Gmail inbox started as a facade), and how to make OKRs actually useful. The episode is a toolkit for building high-impact products under uncertainty.
summary.zh: Itamar 主张把团队从“基于观点”的决策转向“基于证据”的决策，并分享了实现它的实用框架：信心计量表（confidence meter）、指标树（metrics trees）、GIST 与 GIST 看板，以及对人们如何误用 ICE 做优先级排序的批评。他还讲了如何运行有效的“假门测试”和“绿野仙踪测试”（包括 Gmail 的分页收件箱最初只是一个 facade），以及如何让 OKR 真正有用。这期节目是在不确定性下打造高影响力产品的工具箱。
